body:
Found during independent acceptance verification of I01-I07 on `main` at `d42e859f` (group B, observation O4). Low severity.

## What happens

While the API is unreachable, the run inspector replaces the whole run page with an Offline notice. The last-known state of the run, including a pending delivery, is hidden until the API returns. Nothing false is claimed.

## Expected

During an outage the inspector keeps showing the last-known run evidence, clearly marked as possibly out of date, with the offline notice beside it, so the user can still read what was last observed.

## Evidence

`docs/qa/2026-10-26-acceptance-b/README.md` ("Observed outside scope", O4), carried to `main` with the acceptance records.

## Delivery — intent 5 admission, November 22
